content: function Initialize [SWS_CORE_10003] Upstream: RS_AP_00155 Result < void > Initialize (int &argc, char **argv) noexcept; Initialization of the ARA framework. Prior to this call, interaction with the ARA is not allowed with the exception of types intended to be used independently of initialization as defined in [SWS_CORE_15002] . It is strongly recommended to make this call in a place where it is guaranteed that static initialization has completed. This is done to allow injection and interpretation of vendor specific ARA configuration information. The injected arguments are removed in accordance with [SWS_CORE_15006] . Error scenarios, such as corrupted configuration files, are expected to be handled in an implementation-defined way - either as a Non-Standardized Violation ( [SWS_CORE_00003] ) or as a vendor-specific error code ( [SWS_CORE_00092] ).
